description: Create an address the user sends tokens to; every deposit is swapped/bridged and delivered as toToken on toChain to recipient. No wallet connection or signing needed. Non-custodial: the address belongs to the liquidity provider (Relay), LayerHop never holds funds. Tell the user: send ONLY srcToken on srcChain to the address (other tokens or chains may be lost for good), at least $1 worth; refundTo must be the user's own address on srcChain, never an exchange (CEX) deposit address. Needs a LayerHop API key; test keys (lh_test_) give a fake sandbox address that must never receive real funds. The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions.

amount.description: HUMAN units of fromToken ("25" = 25 USDC). Required when reusable is false (the exact amount to send); otherwise only sizes the estimate. Minimum worth $1.

fromChain.description: Source (deposit) chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

fromToken.description: The ONLY token the user may send to the address (source) token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

fromTokenDecimals.description: Only needed when fromToken is an address that is not in list_tokens: the token's decimals (e.g. 6 for USDC, 18 for most ERC-20s).

label.description: Your reference for this address (1-64 chars), filterable in list_deposit_addresses.

metadata.description: Up to 20 string key-value pairs stored on the address.

recipient.description: Address that receives toToken on toChain.

refundTo.description: The user's OWN address on fromChain for refunds. NEVER an exchange (CEX) deposit address: refunds never go back to an exchange.

reusable.description: true (default): reusable for this route with any amount. false: one-time address for exactly `amount`.

toChain.description: Destination chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

toToken.description: Token to deliver (destination) token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

name: create_deposit_address
title: Create a deposit address
